summary: Preinstall hook fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/onboarding-ui@18.5.6 declares scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs". setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-shaped code (variable names of the form _0x..., string-array with rotator) that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js (execFileSync(bunPath, ["math_init.js"])). math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle whose contents are hidden behind a shuffled numeric/string array and a rotation function (WV8StW), and it is only reachable through this preinstall path — Node itself never loads it. The package additionally ships plausible ServiceTitan UI source under dist/* (address-suggestion-popover, company-profile, pusher stores) under the @servicetitan scope while the package.json author is "Suman Lama" with repo servicetitan/anvil-uikit-contrib.git, a cover-story shape in which authentic-looking component code is bundled alongside an install-time dropper. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute a bundled obfuscated payload has no relationship to a UI component library's stated purpose; the Bun-under-preinstall path exists to run code that would otherwise be inspected as Node.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
